| Angola | 1,242  | 6,118.905 | 4,876.905 |
| Argentina | 10,895 | 18,292.318 | 7,397.318 |

*Source: Our World in Data – Maddison Project Database (CSV export).*

**Answer**  
Out of the four countries, **Albania** and **Algeria** each experienced an increase in GDP per capita from 1985 to 2022 that exceeded $8,000.
